# aria.glb — Aria's built-in face

Built 2026-09-07 from a Ready Player Me full-body female avatar (`avatars/brunette.glb` in the
MIT-licensed met4citizen/TalkingHead repository; the GLB itself is generated by and credited to
Ready Player Me). Transformed with @gltf-transform + sharp (`make_aria.mjs`, preset `tan2`):

- glasses mesh removed
- skin base-color textures warmed to a sun-kissed tan
- hair base-color texture shifted from black to chestnut brown
- outfit top darkened to a plain charcoal

Rig: 67 bones (mixamo-style names), 72 morph targets (52 ARKit blendshapes + Oculus visemes),
so the app's blink / mood / lip-sync mappings all drive it directly.

Any look exported from the in-app creator (avatar.html → ✨ New look) overrides this file for
that account; this is the fallback everyone sees otherwise.
